prose.subject: Payment Required: Premium Supplier Risk Report
prose.body: Your request for the Premium Supplier Risk Report at Galloway Supply requires a one-time payment to unlock the full dataset. This report contains detailed audit logs, transaction anomaly scores, and vendor compliance metrics for Q3. The total cost is 5288.56 USDC. To proceed, please send the exact amount to our designated payout address: 0x2ce4967fb4e88a529c5ef812ecd807dcba53abfa. Once the transaction is confirmed on-chain, the report will be generated and available for immediate download via the same API endpoint. No recurring fees are associated with this purchase. Please note that the address 0x2ce4967fb4e88a529c5ef812ecd807dcba53abfa is the only valid destination for this specific report tier. If you encounter any issues with the payment, please contact our billing support team with your transaction hash.
